name: Bothive Chatbot
description: Integrates the Bothive (bothive.be) chatbot into Drupal.
project_description:
The Bothive chatbot module embeds the chatbot widget from https://bothive.be and allows you to configure it.

 In order for you to use this module you'll need to have a valid API key and have your website whitelisted as an allowed domain to be able to embed the chatbot.

 Features 
 
 Specify on which pages the chatbot is displayed. 
 Load the bot in a hidden state so you can decide when it's displayed or not with JavaScript. 
 
 Resources 
 
 Full documentation is available: Bothive chatbot 
 For a complete list of features and functionalities visit: https://bothive.be 
 
 Notes / Known Issues 
 
 You can sign up for a free account on https://bothive.be but you'll be limited in the amount of configuration options and features available to you. 
 This module is not developed nor maintained by anyone from Bothive. 
 
 Credits 
 Initial development and currently maintained by Bram Driesen.
